subject: Late screen incident
body:
Screen observation — Kofi Mensah

At 23:55 a pale face appeared on the classroom's main screen. The teaching room was empty when I looked in. I couldn't identify a person from the image.

IT found no screen-cast record. I have no explanation for what produced the picture, and I don't want that absence turned into a claim that I saw somebody operating it.

I'm recording the display and time here because the first question at reception was already whether this was another student clip. Compare the actual reports before combining separate observations into one story.
title: Late screen incident
